entries.notes: New field on ContactContent.form, first copy 2026-08-25. Shown when the POST does not return ok, inline beside the still-live submit button, role="alert". State, then two actions (references/product/errors.md) — press the button again, or reach a person. No cause: the component is handed none, and 429, 5xx and a dead network are one state to the reader; naming one would be a guess printed as a fact, and a status code would be PRODUCT_TECHNICAL_LEAKAGE. No apology — `rất tiếc` / `có lỗi xảy ra` are the vi generic-failure patterns and vi.md's error rule is state, then action. `Chưa`, not `Không`: the failure is retryable and the word says so. ENDS ON A COLON BY REQUIREMENT — the component appends `{phone} · {email}` immediately after this string, so a full stop here would strand a phone number as its own sentence. Neither value is retyped into vi.ts; both stay in web/content/site.ts.
